_notice: SYNTHETIC: invented for the CMU/Emeritus capstone. Not a real request; no real names, customers, programs, part numbers, lots, documents or results.
title: [SYNTHETIC] Temperature rise, parallel-board fixture
source: synthetic, written to mirror patterns in a private library of real requests

step3_rows.testsToBePerformed: Temperature rise on the 2 samples supplied. Increase current in steps until a 30 °C rise. Two thermocouples per sample, one on each side of the contact array. Record voltage at each step. Expected current 2-3 A.

fields.additionalInformation: Parallel-board version of the series-board test in SYN-LR-PRIOR-01. One test per sample. Each sample is assembled with 2 press-fit pins and 8 screws; tape covers the middle screw holes to prevent shorting.

good_practice: 'temperature rise' has no procedure in the assistant's library.
Item 1: SYN-40101 is not in the parts directory.

why_good: Points to the earlier test and says what is different this time.
Gives the stopping point (30 °C rise) and the thermocouple locations.
States the expected current, so the lab can choose the supply and range in advance.
gaps: No standard cited for temperature rise (EIA-364-70 is the usual method).
No lot; ambient and airflow not stated.
